notes.title: Update 1.0.2 is now live!
notes.content:
[p]This update introduces [b]4 Steam achievements[/b] to the [i]God Syndrome[/i] Demo — and you can already unlock them while playing.[/p][p]🏆 [b]Three achievements[/b] are tied to completing the game with ranks [b]S[/b], [b]SS[/b], and [b]SSS[/b] — a reward for those who demonstrate true skill and perseverance.
🃏 The fourth achievement is awarded for [b]defeating the card dealer flawlessly in all five rounds[/b] — a real challenge for the most dedicated players![/p][p]🧭 We’ve also improved the experience of exploring the labyrinth.
Based on player feedback, transitioning between areas sometimes required waiting too long for the interactive button to appear, causing the game to miss the first click.
In version 1.0.2, we’ve reduced the interface delay to [b]just 0.02 seconds[/b], making movement through the maze [b]much faster and more responsive[/b].[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who plays the demo and shares their feedback — your support helps us make the game better ❤️[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update: Balance Adjustments, Bonus Time & Ukrainian Trailer
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45306585/74a6b9f499dbe98ccc7bd01d222188f0a22f37f4.png"][/img]This small but meaningful update brings several balance changes to the demo version, making it more accessible to new players. Here's what's new:[/p][p]🔹 [b]Easy difficulty[/b] is now even easier:[/p][list][*][p]A regular card game win now gives you [b]200 seconds[/b] (previously 130).[/p][/*][*][p]A perfect win gives [b]300 seconds[/b] (previously 200).[/p][/*][*][p]A draw gives [b]100 seconds[/b] (previously 30).[/p][/*][*][p]Starting a new game with the intro skipped now grants a [b]bonus 200 seconds[/b] at the beginning.[/p][/*][/list][p]🔹 [b]Normal difficulty[/b] has also been slightly adjusted:[/p][list][*][p]A regular win now gives [b]120 seconds[/b] (previously 90).[/p][/*][*][p]A perfect win gives [b]200 seconds[/b] (previously 150).[/p][/*][/list][p]🎬 [b]A Ukrainian-localized trailer for the full game[/b] has been added to the end of the demo.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who provided feedback — your input helps us make the game better![/p]
